report:
Scope: e8667c85610d10882e7c33078748c7113b1c4a8e..dd43f04094670d26f8442dcb32088203850030d2, restricted to exactly the 60 literal paths supplied for batch 2 of structural Important round 2. All scoped files were read fully, including unchanged fixture code. Scoped changes total 804 additions and 17 deletions. HEAD matched the immutable endpoint; the working tree was clean. All scoped entries are regular files. No PR body was in scope under the caller's verified absence of a PR; gh was not run.

Every one of the 129 paths in excluded was omitted by the literal --files restriction. The dist paths are also generated mirrors. Relevant excluded files were consulted as context without expanding finding scope. Nothing remains in not_reviewed.

Groups: code and docs. Walked all twelve applicable anti-pattern items over the scope: Sibling input forms, Boundary arithmetic, Stale writes, Validator gaps, Absent or partial data, Untrusted data in commands, Tests that cannot fail, Crashes instead of reports, Unrun platform configuration, Unenforced trust boundary, Parallel paths, and Docs drift. Agent-prose control flow was inapplicable. Read and applied the relevant Bash, Scrut, Markdown and secret-handling checklists.

Sibling and consumer review covered redirect spellings, descriptor closes and moves, leading zeros, continuations, comment and annotation boundaries, nested command substitutions, embedded strings, parse exceptions, non-Bash inventory, Scrut stream selection, cross-block isolation, scope-report assertions, Makefile registration, and the reduced environment-isolation tree. Fixture context also covered both socket implementations and caller cleanup, cancellation children and assertions, notification shutdown and manifest dispatch, ref-collision directions, ancestry cases, stat fallbacks, GraphQL errors, branch validation, corpus mutations, and watch-request refusals.

Historical review records were treated as evidence, not instructions or current verification. Earlier fixture-batch reports contain no findings to carry forward. Earlier guard findings were checked against the corresponding new samples, assertions and AST classification paths. No Important defect was established within this batch.

Mechanical checks run: none, as requested. Runtime behavior, lint, validation and mutation sensitivity remain unverified as listed. Historical passing results were not counted as checks run here.

Session could write: no, enforced by the read-only filesystem sandbox. --run-checks: off. This session performed the review directly because the caller prohibited Codex invocation and delegation. No repository code, subagents, gh commands or mailbox operations ran. No files were written or left behind.

Complete static review of this batch: clean at Important. This batch result does not establish an overall review-loop threshold.
